verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce supplies the payment rails for agent checkout. It provides agent-specific tokens, passkey-authenticated purchase intents, and credential retrieval scoped to merchant and amount. Merchants get Trusted Agent Protocol signatures and payment containers to accept agent-initiated orders, and an MCP toolkit lets agents create payment links. However, it is infrastructure the agent or merchant must integrate, not a turnkey in-chat checkout, and the docs say the product is still "in the process of development and deployment." The only link to a named assistant is a community reaction to news of a ChatGPT tie-in. Missing for 10: documented first-party checkout inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Copilot; merchant catalog/product exposure to assistant surfaces; production GA status; independent hands-on corroboration of end-to-end in-chat purchases.
